system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Input context: System prompt, memory, skills, and tool prompts define what the agent starts with.
system_prompt_style.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Summarization and context offloading
system_prompt_style.note: Composed from user prompt, memory, skills, tool prompts via middleware; code not in bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Virtual filesystem access
env_context_strategy.note: Default filesystem tools ls/read_file/glob/grep; AGENTS.md memory injected when configured.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Compression: Built-in offloading and summarization compress conversation history and large intermediate results.
context_compaction.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Summarization and context offloading
context_compaction.note: Offloading large tool results to disk coded as tool_output_pruning.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Also supports returning multimodal content blocks for non-text files (images, video, audio, and documents).
observation_format.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Virtual filesystem access
observation_format.note: Images from read_file mapped to screenshots (closest value).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local
tool_call_format.note: Optional QuickJS eval tool (code_as_action) is opt-in interpreter; not coded as default parser.

tool_count.note: Docs list ls, read_file, write_file, edit_file, delete, glob, grep plus task tool (8) and execute with sandbox backends, but tool registry source not in bundle to confirm exact default count.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: edit_file Perform exact string replacements in files (with global replace mode)
edit_primitive.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Virtual filesystem access

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Pass custom functions, LangChain tools, or tools from any MCP server with the tools= parameter.
tool_schema_source.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Tools and MCP
tool_schema_source.note: Custom functions converted from signatures/docstrings (LangChain tools); inferred.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Deep Agents fully support the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
protocol_standardization.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Tools and MCP
protocol_standardization.note: other = Agent Client Protocol via libs/acp ("Use deep agents in code editors with ACP").

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It is the same core tool calling loop as other agent frameworks
loop_primitives.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Core capabilities

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Starting in v0.7 task planning is opt-in only. In earlier versions, task planning middleware was included by default.
planning_granularity.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Task planning
planning_granularity.note: explicit_plan_object (write_todos) reachable via TodoListMiddleware; default has none, coded implicit as closest.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Use the default general-purpose subagent (enabled by default) or define custom subagents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The harness includes a built-in task tool that lets the main agent create ephemeral subagents for isolated, long-running, multi-step, or parallel tasks.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: interrupt_on accepts a mapping of tool names to interrupt configurations.
human_in_loop.note: Off by default; enabled per tool via interrupt_on.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Tasks support status tracking ('pending', 'in_progress', 'completed') and are persisted in agent state.
short_term_state.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Task planning
short_term_state.note: LangGraph agent state includes virtual filesystem files; todos opt-in.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Memory uses AGENTS.md files that you pass through the memory parameter when creating the agent.

self_verification.note: Middleware stack source not in bundle; examples/rubric_middleware exists but not opened.

retry_policy.note: Run loop source not in bundle.

rollback.note: Tool list in docs has no undo, but LangGraph checkpointing may allow state rewind; source not in bundle.

termination_condition.note: Run loop and limit config not in bundle.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Prompt caching is enabled by default when using an Anthropic model, or a Bedrock model (Claude or Nova).
cost_controls.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Prompt caching
cost_controls.note: Budget/routing config not visible in bundle.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The harness provides a configurable virtual filesystem which can be backed by different pluggable backends: in-memory state, local disk, LangGraph store, composite routing
execution_isolation.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Virtual filesystem access
execution_isolation.note: Default appears in-process virtual state backend with no execute; sandbox/remote backends optional.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The harness provides a configurable virtual filesystem which can be backed by different pluggable backends: in-memory state, local disk, LangGraph store, composite routing
filesystem_access.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Virtual filesystem access
filesystem_access.note: Permission rules can scope paths; local disk backend reachable.

network_policy.note: No network configuration surface in bundle.

permission_model.evidence_quote: If no rule matches, the operation is allowed.
permission_model.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Filesystem permissions
permission_model.note: Declarative allow/deny path rules (static_allowlist) and interrupt_on approvals opt-in.

tracing.evidence_quote: first-class tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith

replayability.note: No replay facility visible in bundle.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Permissions apply to the built-in filesystem tools listed above and are evaluated in declaration order with first-match-wins semantics.
guardrails.evidence_locator: docs Deep Agents overview, Filesystem permissions

target_domain.evidence_quote: You can use deep agents for any task, including complex, multi-step tasks.
target_domain.note: swe via Deep Agents Code; research example.

open_source.evidence_quote: Deep Agents is an open source agent harness
open_source.note: MIT badge; LICENSE file not opened.

first_release_date.note: First tag date not in bundle.
